tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window background behind every panel. Material 3 role: surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the sidebar and tables. Material 3 role: surfaceContainer.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, the active nav item and anything nested inside a surface. Material 3 role: surfaceContainerHigh.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders, table rules and dividers. Decorative only: never the only boundary of a control. Material 3 role: outlineVariant.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text, headings and figures on bg, surface and surface-raised. Also reference lines in charts. Material 3 role: onSurface.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, provenance lines ('entered by you'), inactive nav items. Passes 4.5:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised in every theme. Material 3 role: onSurfaceVariant.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, focus and 'this' in charts. One accent per screen region. Material 3 role: primary.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills. Material 3 role: onPrimary.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the active nav item, 'up to date' and 'funded' badges. Text on it uses text. Material 3 role: secondaryContainer.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Things that need the family: import due, needs you, short, over. Never alarming red. Always paired with words, never colour alone. Deliberately differs from accent in lightness in every theme (the desktop example is nudged from tertiary for this reason). Material 3 role: tertiary.

tokens.name: attention-soft
tokens.usage: Background for attention badges, banners and the 'short' month in the ribbon. Text on it uses text. Material 3 role: tertiaryContainer.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Only for destructive actions (delete everything, undo an import) and real errors (a file that can't be read). Not for overspending. Material 3 role: error.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background for error messages and the confirm step of destructive actions. Material 3 role: errorContainer.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px outline, 2px offset. Never removed.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: The series or bar the chart is about.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second segment in a proportional bar, or comparison series (last month). A tint of accent, so it differs in lightness, not hue. Material 3 role: primaryContainer.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third segment or background context series. Lightest tint of accent.

tokens.name: chart-track
tokens.usage: The empty part of a tick scale or bar.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Ticks and gridlines. Quieter than reference lines.

tokens.name: chart-ref
tokens.usage: Reference lines: targets and limits the family set (buffer target, 5× debt limit). Always labelled.

tokens.name: glass-panel
tokens.usage: Panel fill when the Glass setting is on, with backdrop blur glass-blur. Replaces surface. Opacity keeps text at 4.5:1 over any wallpaper.

tokens.name: glass-panel-strong
tokens.usage: Glass for text-heavy panels: assistant notes, the review draft, Ask or find.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px border on glass panels, in place of line.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind Ask or find and other overlays. Material 3 role: scrim.

styles.name: title-screen
styles.usage: One per screen: the screen's name.

styles.name: title-section
styles.usage: Section and card headings. Often phrased as the question the section answers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Food finished October 1,840 kr over its job.
styles.usage: All running text, assistant notes, buttons (at 500 weight).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Badges, chips, form labels, nav badges.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Provenance lines and fine print. Muted colour; never for instructions.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The value of a vital sign or the headline figure of a card.

styles.name: figure-l
styles.usage: Group totals and secondary figures in summaries.

styles.name: table
styles.usage: Every table cell holding amounts, dates or counts; transaction lists.

styles.name: data-caption
styles.usage: Scale labels, axis labels and evidence lines under figures. Uppercase only for these short labels.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Dense within a card, spacious between sections.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its label; between stacked lines of a figure.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips and buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside chips and badges; between rows of a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding in Instrument; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding in Hearth.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between a section title and its content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections of a screen; main area side padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top padding of a screen; space above the screen title.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tick-scale bars, table row highlights.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Key chips, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and list containers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Panels, the sidebar in glass mode, Ask or find.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pill buttons and status pills.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards in Hearth light only. Every other theme separates with surface and line.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Glass panels when the Glass setting is on.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Ask or find and other overlays above the scrim.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything clickable.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons and chips.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Navigation and section icons.

tokens.name: key-chip
tokens.usage: The boxed shortcut letter beside each sidebar item.

tokens.name: scale-height
tokens.usage: Value bar thickness in a tick scale.

tokens.name: proportion-height
tokens.usage: Height of a proportional bar.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur radius for glass panels (with saturate 140%).
